title: Priests, Priestesses & Oracles
reason: The outdated claims (fixed eagle/raven omen rules and asserting priests put the Pythia's words into verse without qualification) are standard GCSE-level simplifications and illustrative examples that would not cost marks in an exam.

pedantry.quote: An eagle flying to the right? Awesome, good omen, proceed. A raven appearing on the left? Terrible omen, stop everything immediately.
The priests of the sanctuary would have to take her cryptic, trance-like utterances and translate them into dangerously ambiguous poetry for the person asking the question.
